gap_decisions.title: Described point (`@m1`) inside `line` operand of `distance` goal
gap_decisions.2_root_cause_type: Schema & Bridge lowering limitation (`_resolve_line_2` requires raw vertex tokens in `solid_vertices` and rejects `@point_id` references).
3_files_and_functions_affected: backend/app/simulation/geometry_functions/planner.py (`_loai_muc_tieu` for point-to-line distance with derived line endpoints)
gap_decisions.5_regression_risk: LOW-MEDIUM (touches `_resolve_line_2` used across all line premises and goals).
gap_decisions.6_impact_on_determinism_and_fail_closed: Preserves determinism if `@point_id` is resolved through `point_map` after `described_points` lowering.
gap_decisions.7_impact_on_latency_and_combinatorial_se: Negligible (+0.2 ms; no search branching if `@m1` is already a deterministic `trung_diem` / `chia_doan`).
gap_decisions.10_rationale: Current fail-closed refusal (`BRIDGE_INVALID_REFERENCE`) is 100% deterministic and safe; deferring avoids changing `bridge_v2` contract version during release stabilization.

gap_decisions.title: Multiple described points (`@m1`, `@n1`) referenced simultaneously in a single `distance` goal
gap_decisions.2_root_cause_type: Bridge operand resolver & Planner goal dependency ordering for multi-point derived segments.
gap_decisions.6_regression_and_fail_closed_impact: Safe if both `@m1` and `@n1` are resolved via `point_map` before emitting `khoang_cach_diem_diem`.
gap_decisions.10_rationale: Preserves strict XFAIL contract on `MG5` without altering `typed-fact-next-bridge/2` during release stabilization.

gap_decisions.title: Named 3-point section plane `(Q)` loses `plane_name` when lowered to explicit 3-point plane `(MNP)`
gap_decisions.2_root_cause_type: Source Gate / Bridge representation gap: `typed_fact_next_bridge.py:422-451` lowers a 3-point `DerivedSectionSpec(plane_name='Q', points=['@m1','@n1','@p1'])` to `(M, N, P)` without carrying the alias `'Q'`, while the goal quote says `thiết diện cắt bởi (Q)`.
gap_decisions.5_regression_risk: MEDIUM (touches `mat_cat_dung_nguon` in Source Gate, which guards against hallucinated section planes).
gap_decisions.6_impact_on_determinism_and_fail_closed: Must verify that `plane_name` `(Q)` is explicitly anchored in the `DerivedSectionSpec.quote` before accepting `(Q) -> (MNP)` in `mat_cat_dung_nguon`.
gap_decisions.10_rationale: Source Gate (`mat_cat_dung_nguon`) is a critical safety barrier; keeping `SE3` and `HB36` as strict XFAILs avoids weakening `SOURCE_OBJECT_MISMATCH` before H-1.

gap_decisions.title: 3+ property-defined points in one problem exceed `MAX_EFFECT_CANDIDATES = 48` / `MAX_MEMORY_DECLARATIONS = 32`
gap_decisions.5_regression_risk: MEDIUM (raising caps without relevance pruning increases worst-case planner latency).
gap_decisions.6_impact_on_determinism_and_fail_closed: Goal-cone relevance filtering must remain strictly deterministic.
gap_decisions.7_impact_on_latency_and_combinatorial_se: Directly affects worst-case search branching if caps are raised naively.
gap_decisions.10_rationale: Current bounded caps guarantee p95 planner latency < 7 ms across all 118 Dev + Held-Out cases and fail closed with `OUT_OF_SCOPE`.

gap_decisions.title: Nested described point defined over an `orthocenter` (`truc_tam`) point
gap_decisions.2_root_cause_type: Bridge + Registry capability boundary (`orthocenter` is not yet a first-class lowered construction primitive in `typed_fact_next_bridge.py` + `registry.py`).
gap_decisions.5_regression_risk: MEDIUM (adds a new Registry function and Engine constructor).
gap_decisions.6_impact_on_determinism_and_fail_closed: Requires non-collinearity check (`COLLINEAR_POINTS`) on the triangle vertices.
gap_decisions.7_impact_on_latency_and_combinatorial_se: Adds 1 point-producing function to Registry candidate pool.
gap_decisions.10_rationale: Adding a new Registry function would bump `geometry-functions/33` -> `/34`; deferring preserves frozen Registry `/33` and Planner `/26` identity for H-1.
